bias.en: Pullback · lost the 100-day, above the Aug 18 low
bias.zh: 回调 · 跌破 100 日均线，守在 8月18日低点上方

read.en: Microsoft fell 2.8% on Nov 20 to $484.52, its lowest close since Aug 21, trading $481.03–503.80 on 1.64x average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($503.1), 10-day ($516.2) and 30-day ($526.3) and just under the rising 100-day ($486.8), above the rising 200-day ($443.6). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 10, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 17 ($555.47), and RSI is 34.8.
read.zh: 微软 11月20日下跌 2.8%，收于 $484.52，为 8月21日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $481.03–503.80，成交放量（为 20 日均量的 1.64 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$503.1）、10 日（$516.2）和 30 日均线（$526.3）下方，均在下行，略低于上行的 100 日均线（$486.8），在上行的 200 日均线（$443.6）上方。MACD 自 11月10日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月17日起看空（$555.47），RSI 为 34.8。

read.en: The close broke the $496.5 (Nov 17 low) and $486 (100-day, Sep 10 low) supports, now resistance, but held above the Aug 18 low ($477.15). Resistance is $486–489.7, then $496.5–503.8 (Nov 20 high, 5-day) and $516 (10-day). Support is $477.2–483.7 (Aug 18 and Nov 20 lows), then $469.5–475.2 (December and January lows) and $465. A close above $489.7 would target $496.5–503.8; below $477.2, $469.5–475.
